refractive_index: n decreases across visible and near infrared wavelengths, with significant change at 1.8 eV (690 nm)
evidence: The X-ray diffraction pattern of Cu2S thin films grown at a deposition temperature of 135 /C14 C (grey) and 80 /C14 C (brown) on fused quartz (top traces) and porous anodic aluminum oxide membranes (bottom traces). The fused quartz traces have been o ffset for clarity and the 80 /C14 C trace scaled by a factor of 2 for improved visibility. The powder pattern for low-chalcocite (00-023-0961) is included for comparison.
